I’d prefer dedicated “include these tags” and “exclude these tags” pickers when creating a saved filter, with suggestions from my existing tags. The search expression can still be retained for people who use it, but the picker makes the saved filter easier to understand and edit later.

A saved filter should remember its name, search text, included tags, and excluded tags. I would not include the current All, Read later, or Archived tab in it; those views describe where a bookmark currently sits, while the saved filter describes the subject I want to return to. I should be able to apply the same saved filter within the appropriate view.

With that adjustment, the saved-filter behaviour matches what I had in mind.
